summary_en: Kamgras 1 raised its public acquisition offer price for Kakaku.com from 3,681 yen to 3,682 yen per share, extending the tender period to October 28, 2026, for a total of 115 business days. The price adjustment follows repeated revisions since the offer commenced on May 13, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Change in Terms and Conditions of Public Acquisition Offer for Kakaku.com, Inc. (Security Code: 2371) by Kamgras 1 Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On October 14, 2026, Kamgras 1 Corporation announced an amendment to its public acquisition offer for Kakaku.com, Inc., which commenced on May 13, 2026. The bidder raised the offer price from 3,681 yen to 3,682 yen per share and extended the tender period from the original closing date to October 28, 2026, resulting in a total tender period of 115 business days. The bidder submitted an amendment to its acquisition filing and amended previous filings dated from May 19 through September 29, 2026.

According to the disclosure, as of September 29, 2026, Kakaku.com's market price had been trading above the public offer price, creating an uncertain and unstable situation for shareholders. The bidder cited the need to provide shareholders with additional time and a clearer picture as market conditions continued to evolve. The tender offer, which aims to acquire all outstanding shares and acquire warrants for Kakaku.com's delisting, has been subject to multiple price and timing adjustments since its initiation.

The disclosure document includes detailed context regarding a competing acquisition proposal from another party, noting that the persistence of that proposal and related uncertainties have contributed to market price movements above the current offer level. Kamgras 1 stated that the modest price increase and extended tender period reflect its commitment to acquiring all outstanding shares while allowing shareholders adequate opportunity to participate.
